project: Wuxia Life P25 Lifetime Simulation Experience
description: P25 wuxia lifetime simulation: Waves 1-4 complete (mainstream, pinnacle, mixed, ordinary origins with sim baselines and validation slices). North Star section 8 ordinary criterion met.

userStories.title: Lifetime simulation baseline audit
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a read-only audit of current lifetime simulation surfaces so that P25 targets real experience gaps instead of rebuilding existing systems.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit mainstream achievements, composite destiny, rare lines, origin surfaces, choice/outcome wiring, and endgame summary paths
Map each Ultimate North Star Goal to existing assets: supported, partial, or missing
Record top contradiction risks with concrete event, flag, or file pointers
Save the audit under docs/test-reports/ or docs/designs/
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Write P25 lifetime simulation design rules
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit rules for mainstream achievements, choice channels, and consequence consistency so that later waves converge on one lifetime simulation model.
acceptanceCriteria: Define mainstream vs pinnacle vs mixed achievement tiers and requirements
Define active vs event-triggered choice expectations and minimum feedback layers
Define consequence consistency rules aligned with docs/designs/p25-lifetime-simulation-north-star.md section 4.3
Record which Wave 2-4 topics are deferred in Wave 1
Save the rules under docs/designs/

userStories.title: Mainstream achievement coverage and traceability
userStories.description: As a player, I want at least five mainstream wuxia achievements to feel pursuable and earned through multiple strengths so that a full life has clear high-level goals.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve and trace P16 outcomes: grandmaster_guardian, sect_leader_statesman, lone_sword_legend
Add and wire jianghu_renown_sage and medical_sage_healer per PRD section 12 Frozen Decisions
All 5 achievements use composite multi-factor requirements including at least one non-martial mainstream (medical_sage_healer) and one reputation or social-led mainstream (jianghu_renown_sage)
At least 1 achievement blocks on a missing critical dimension even if one axis is strong
Each achievement has inspectable partial-progress reporting in test or sim output
Link each achievement to at least 1 choice flag and 1 mid-life consequence surface
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Choice consequence feedback standard
userStories.description: As a player, I want both my plans and event choices to show what changed and what it means later so that the life simulation feels consequential.
acceptanceCriteria: Document and apply required feedback layers: immediate narrative, visible impact, future implication
Cover both active planning actions and event-triggered choices on priority paths
Key choices write long-term state readable by later events or summary signals
Remove or fix cases where key choices only modify hidden values without player-facing explanation
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Consequence consistency validation slice
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a validation slice that detects narrative/state contradictions so that P25 does not ship logically broken life paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a validation slice or report covering at least 3 representative life paths
Check for causal breaks, ghost flags, and mutually exclusive state at summary time
Record pass/fail with concrete event, flag, and summary pointers for each failure
Save report under docs/test-reports/
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: P25 simulation acceptance baseline
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a simulation baseline for lifetime goals so that later tuning uses before/after evidence instead of impressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Define commands, sample count, seed range, and metrics for achievement reachability and path divergence
Run baseline and save JSON under docs/test-reports/
Include achievement unlock rates, path divergence proxy, and high-severity contradiction count
Document acceptance direction for Wave 1 only
Do not modify gameplay behavior beyond adding reporting if needed

userStories.title: Wave 1 experience rebalance pass
userStories.description: As a player, I want Wave 1 improvements applied across the full life arc so that mainstream goals and choice consequences are felt in play, not only in reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Apply bounded content or config changes so mainstream achievements are pursuable without extreme luck
Fix top contradiction failures identified in US-005
Improve at least 1 measurable baseline metric from US-006 without regressing gates
Document optimization layer choice per simulation-driven workflow
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: P25 Wave 1 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a Wave 1 closure report so that Discovery can propose Wave 2 stories against explicit remaining gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize Wave 1 before/after metrics and gate results
Map each Ultimate North Star Goal to met, partial, or missing with evidence paths
List recommended Wave 2 priorities for pinnacle luck gates, mixed achievements, and ordinary origins
Confirm gate:playability and gate:p20 do not regress
Save under docs/test-reports/

userStories.title: Pinnacle achievement tier and dual gate config
userStories.description: As a designer, I want pinnacle-tier composite outcomes with choice-plus-luck dual gates so that the highest achievements cannot be grind-unlocked.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least 2 pinnacle-tier outcomes in profile-first config separate from Wave 1 mainstream set
Each pinnacle outcome requires both valid choice flags and a rare-line or low-probability window flag per North Star section 3.2
Evaluator rejects unlock when only martial or resource axes are maxed without the luck window
Extend design rules doc with pinnacle tier examples and mutex or coexist rules
Inspectable partial progress in sim or test output for choice vs luck unmet dimensions
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass

userStories.title: Rare line randomness wiring and explainability
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want rare-line rolls to affect later opportunity weights with sim-visible explanations so that random memorable moments are traceable.
acceptanceCriteria: Wire getRareLineOpportunityMultiplier into the event scheduling or weight path used by P16 rare line checkpoints
Sim or validation output records why a rare line triggered or missed with flag, window, or weight pointers
No regression to existing 3 rare lines unlock behavior
Document wiring layer choice per simulation-driven workflow
Typecheck passes
Relevant tests pass
userStories.notes: Wave 2; PRD Goals 3 and 8; addresses gap-002
